pages.text:
Ameno was released in 1996 by ERA, a French music project. The song is much older than the meme that eventually grew around it.

Ameno started showing up in internet culture long before 'Dorime' became a common meme. It was used in Twitch streams, videos and remixes, and by the late 2010s the word 'Dorime' had become strongly associated with the song.

The meme is usually paired with the song's dramatic music and vocals, often over pictures of the famous white-robed rat.

Put the disc in a jukebox to play Ameno.
